final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT ft.invoice_number, c.gender, AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS invoice_average FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ft.invoice_number, c.gender), gender_averages AS (SELECT gender, AVG(invoice_average) AS gender_average FROM invoice_averages GROUP BY gender), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(gender_average) AS value FROM gender_averages) SELECT AVG(g.gender_average), AVG(g.gender_average - a.value) FROM gender_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE g.gender_average > a.value
